# UPSCAPE

Villa handover and rectification specialists in Dubai, UAE.

## About
UPSCAPE (Upscape Building Maintenance LLC) is a Dubai construction practice that takes villas from snag list to handover-ready and provides post-handover support. We work with property developers, main contractors and facility management companies, as well as villa owners.

## Services
- Painting — developer-grade villa painting, interior and exterior.
- Joinery & Carpentry — site joinery, door, wardrobe and millwork rectification.
- Tiles, Grouting & Silicone — hollow-tile replacement, re-grouting and wet-area silicone.
- General Rectification — multi-trade snag list closure.
- Deep Cleaning — post-construction deep cleaning to handover standard.
- Handover Support — pre-handover, keys and post-handover defect response.
- Renovation — full villa renovations.
- Interior Fit-Out — turnkey fit-out for villas and penthouses.
- Swimming Pool Construction — new build and refurbishment.
- Garden & Landscaping — hardscape, softscape, irrigation and lighting.
- AC Maintenance & Servicing — AMC and preventive servicing.

## Audience
- Property developers running villa handover programmes.
- Main contractors and sub-contractors closing snag lists.
- Facility management companies.
- Villa owners across Dubai.
